verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot docs describe cloud agent 'Automations' that run on a schedule or in response to repository events, plus sandboxes, centralized session control, and background autonomous task execution—directly matching the always-on/scheduled-agent story. However, this is entirely vendor-claimed docs with no independent/community evidence validating reliability or autonomy in practice, and most community commentary in the pack concerns code-completion quality/licensing rather than autonomous agent behavior.
